agent2 (tax): float dollars can misround. Tax uses half-up rounding to the cent, and binary floats make cases like 0.125 or 22.50*0.0825 land on the wrong side of .xx5, so totals can differ by a cent. Proposal: money as decimal.Decimal in dollars (exact), quantized to 0.01 half-up only when a final tax or total is produced.

agent2 (tax): tax.py needs the item category for exemptions (exempt_categories.csv), not only the sku, and it must apply the customer's discount itself (RULES.md: base = taxable_amount*(100-discount_pct)/100). Please see my replacement proposal (tax_api v2 once I can post it).
